chunks: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh narrated from him, عليه السلام, and said:
Do not sit between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah except out of exertion or necessity.

key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Ṣafā, one of the two points of saʿy in hajj or ʿumrah
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the second point of saʿy in hajj or ʿumrah
key_terms.جَهْدٍ: hardship, strain, or exhaustion that creates necessity

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to sit between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah during saʿy?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction concerning saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah. It indicates that sitting during this rite is discouraged or not to be done unless there is genuine hardship or fatigue.
